content.text: For digital creators in Nigeria, Ghana, and other regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-how-one-creator|COREMERCH guide to payment]] restrictions and currency collapses are a harsh reality, building a sovereign digital commerce stack is the only way to truly own their infrastructure and stay in control. Despite the limitations, the status quo has been renting a platform – Gumroad, Payhip, or Stripe – that charges 10% on every sale, leaving creators with little room for profit. NOWPayments, on the other hand, charges a mere 0.5% on every transaction, and with the right [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-what-actually|Cloudflare R2]]-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks|architecture]], you can sell ebooks, courses, templates, and digital products without relying on these platforms. By deploying a sovereign digital commerce stack, you can break free from these onerous fees and ensure that your customers receive the goods they purchase, without any intermediaries holding them back. This breakdown will walk you through the process of building your own digital product store with no-KYC payments, using the tools and components designed specifically for the needs of creators like you.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-selling-digital-products-crypto-works-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Digital product

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not just a collection of tools and services – it's a fundamental shift in how you think about your infrastructure. Instead of renting a platform that controls the flow of money, you're building a custom solution that puts you in complete control. With a sovereign stack, you can choose the payment gateways, the delivery mechanisms, and the storage solutions that best suit your needs, without being held hostage by third-party providers. This approach is not just about avoiding fees – it's about owning your data, your customer relationships, and your entire commerce experience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The heart of any sovereign digital commerce stack is the combination of GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Sites for hosting, along with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for handling payment processing. These components work together seamlessly to provide an automated delivery mechanism that ensures customers receive their purchases instantly, without any manual intervention. By using a decentralized storage solution like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, you can store and deliver your digital products with ease, while Supabase or Google Sheets handle order storage and management.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators like you, who sell ebooks, courses, templates, and digital products in regions where payment restrictions and currency collapses are a common occurrence. With the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your own sovereign digital commerce stack, including all 6 blueprints and 7 templates. Whether you're an indie author, a course creator, or a software developer, this kit will give you the tools and expertise you need to break free from the limitations of traditional platforms and build a custom commerce solution that suits your needs.
Build a custom commerce solution that suits your needs, without relying on third-party providers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

So, what exactly are the components that make up a sovereign digital commerce stack? At the core, you'll need a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Sites to host your digital products. Then, you'll need a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery and payment processing. NOWPayments will handle payment processing, while Supabase or Google Sheets will manage orders and storage. With Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive, you'll have a decentralized storage solution to deliver your digital products instantly. And, with the Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll get everything you need to build, deploy, and scale your own sovereign digital commerce stack.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Now that you have the knowledge and the tools you need, it's time to deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack. To get started, visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html and purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, as well as instant access to our documentation, support, and expertise. With this kit, you'll be able to build, deploy, and scale your own sovereign digital commerce stack in no time, and start selling your digital products with confidence and control.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The most important question on everyone's mind is: how do I avoid the fees charged by traditional platforms like Gumroad or Payhip? The answer is simple: build your own sovereign digital commerce stack using tools like NOWPayments, GitHub Pages, and Cloudflare Workers. By doing so, you'll be able to process payments at a fraction of the cost, with NOWPayments charging a mere 0.5% on every transaction. This means that at 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you'll retain $921 more in profit than if you were using Gumroad. That's a huge difference, and one that can make all the difference in your business.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your own sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these concrete steps: (1) choose a hosting solution like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Sites to host your digital products; (2) select a backend logic solution like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate delivery and payment processing; (3) use NOWPayments to handle payment processing; (4) set up Supabase or Google Sheets to manage orders and storage; (5) use Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive as a decentralized storage solution to deliver your digital products instantly; (6) purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) to get instant access to our documentation, support, and expertise.
